messages.content: The freight carrier just moved the crate delivery to Monday at 4:30 p.m. I need to be at the Denver gallery that afternoon, so the 11:05 flight is now too late. Can we move only the outbound earlier and leave the Thursday evening return and hotel dates alone?

Yes. I’ll look for an earlier Atlanta-Denver flight on Monday, August 18, while keeping the Thursday, August 21 Delta return at 6:40 p.m. I’ll also check whether Catbird can accommodate your earlier arrival or hold your luggage before the room is ready.
Please focus on a nonstop that gives me a comfortable margin. I’ll need to get from the airport to the gallery and be settled before 4:30.

Delta has two earlier nonstops with availability in the same cabin. The first leaves Atlanta at 7:10 a.m. and arrives in Denver at 8:28 a.m.; changing to it would add $46. The second leaves at 8:55 a.m. and arrives at 10:15 a.m.; the fare difference is $21. Neither option changes your Thursday return. Catbird’s standard check-in time is 4:00 p.m. They cannot guarantee that the studio will be ready in the morning, but they will hold your luggage at the front desk at no charge, and they can add an early-arrival request.
Take the 7:10. The extra time is worth the $46. Before you change it, what does that make the full trip total?

The revised airfare would be $492. With the Catbird total of $674.22 and the expected $70 for one checked bag each way unless a waiver applies, the trip estimate becomes $1,236.22. That remains $13.78 under the $1,250 approval. Delta does not charge a separate change fee for this amendment.
Good. Will the checked-bag notation stay on the reservation, and are all three hotel nights still intact?

Yes. The reservation will continue to note one checked bag each way, with the same expected fees payable if no waiver applies. Catbird confirmation CB-481730 remains for one standard studio from Monday, August 18 through Thursday, August 21, with all three nights unchanged. Its cancellation deadline also remains 6:00 p.m. Denver time on August 17.
Then make the flight change and add the early-arrival request to the hotel. No changes to the return, room type, or anything else.

To confirm before I complete it: Delta flight H7Q4LM will be amended to the 7:10 a.m. nonstop from Atlanta on Monday, arriving Denver at 8:28 a.m. The Thursday 6:40 p.m. nonstop return stays as booked. The additional charge is $46, and no insurance or optional services will be added. Catbird will receive only an early-arrival and luggage-hold note.

The Delta change is complete. Confirmation H7Q4LM now shows departure from Atlanta at 7:10 a.m. Monday, August 18, arriving Denver at 8:28 a.m. The Thursday, August 21 return remains at 6:40 p.m. The $46 fare difference was charged, bringing the ticket total to $492. The checked-bag notation remains in place.
And did the hotel confirm the luggage part, or is that only a request?

Catbird confirmed that the front desk will hold your luggage at no charge when you arrive Monday morning. Early access to the standard studio is requested but depends on availability that day; the hotel will contact you if the room becomes ready before the 4:00 p.m. check-in time. Confirmation CB-481730, the three-night stay, room type, rate, and cancellation deadline are unchanged. Your revised expected trip total is $1,236.22, within the existing approval.
